nodes.label: SimX Ecosystem
nodes.description: The complete SimX medical simulation VR training platform.
nodes.content:
## Overview

The SimX ecosystem connects authoring tools, runtime services, customer-facing clients, content infrastructure, and external integrations.

### Notes

Open a node to inspect the relationships that produce, store, retrieve, or consume platform content.

nodes.label: SimX Client
nodes.description: Customer-facing VR application; retrieves mutations and cases from the Admin Portal for sessions.
nodes.content:
## Overview

The VR training client runs learner-facing simulations and connects to backend services for session state and published content.

### Responsibilities

- Retrieves available scenarios and mutations
- Connects to live session infrastructure
- Presents customer-facing training experiences

nodes.label: Session Server
nodes.description: Coordinates multiplayer sessions and parses scenario mutations at runtime.
nodes.content:
## Overview

The Session Server coordinates runtime simulation sessions and applies authored scenario data during live training.

### Responsibilities

- Manages multiplayer session coordination
- Parses scenario mutations
- Serves runtime state to connected clients

nodes.label: Scenario Creator
nodes.description: High-level tool for assembling new simulation scenarios from templates.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Scenario Creator is the high-level authoring entry point for building simulation scenarios from templates.

### Responsibilities

- Starts new scenario authoring workflows
- Opens Scenario Editor for detailed edits
- Tracks authoring work in Jira

nodes.label: Admin Portal
nodes.description: Customer-facing portal for institution admins; hosts published mutations and clinical cases.
nodes.content:
## Overview

The Admin Portal is the customer-facing surface for managing published platform content.

### Responsibilities

- Hosts mutations and clinical cases
- Serves content retrieved by the SimX Client
- Provides institution admin workflows

nodes.label: Scenario Editor
nodes.description: Allows customization of scenarios, mutations, and voice content.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Scenario Editor handles detailed customization of scenario mutations and authored media.

### Responsibilities

- Creates scenario mutation payloads
- Creates voice clip records
- Syncs authoring issues with Jira

nodes.label: Scenario Mutation
nodes.description: Runtime mutation payload produced by the Scenario Editor.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Scenario Mutation is the authored payload consumed by runtime systems to alter simulation behavior.

### Lifecycle

- Created by Scenario Editor
- Published to Admin Portal
- Parsed by Session Server during live sessions

nodes.label: Voice Clip
nodes.description: UGC voice line generated via Eleven Labs integration.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Voice Clip represents generated or uploaded voice content used by authored scenarios.

### Lifecycle

- Created by Scenario Editor
- Generated through Eleven Labs when needed
- Stored in AWS S3 for delivery

nodes.label: AWS S3 Bucket
nodes.description: Stores UGC voice clips for delivery to the client.
nodes.content:
## Overview

AWS S3 stores generated and uploaded voice assets used by authored scenarios.

### Responsibilities

- Stores voice clip objects
- Supports downstream delivery to runtime clients
- Hosts the bucket ingestion process for authored media

nodes.label: Parses Mutations
nodes.description: Session Server ingests and applies scenario mutations during live sessions.

nodes.label: Hosts Mutations and Cases
nodes.description: Central store for published scenario mutations and clinical cases.

nodes.label: Stores UGC Voice Clips
nodes.description: Bucket storage path for authored voice assets.

nodes.label: Eleven Labs
nodes.description: Third-party text-to-speech API used to synthesize voice clips.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Eleven Labs is the external text-to-speech provider used to generate authored voice clips.

### Relationship

It generates Voice Clip data used by Scenario Editor workflows.

nodes.label: Jira
nodes.description: Atlassian issue tracker used by authoring tools for work items.
nodes.content:
## Overview

Jira tracks authoring and engineering work connected to the Scenario Creator and Scenario Editor flows.
